Amazing experience
Sep 2026 • Couples
The food and the sauce are amazing 
Very tender meat (we finish it all right off the grill so no picture unfortunately) 
Our server is super nice and highly professional 
They grill for you so you don’t have to do anything 
They even have small room for family and couple, or standard booth, we choose the small room, it was great and offer some privacy, we love it 
We celebrate a birthday so they even give us a nice cheese cake slice which also delicious by the way 
Highly recommend
